title: Two results
prompt: A function can only return one thing, so to return two numbers we put them in an array. Return [a + b, a * b].
signature: func solve(a: int, b: int) -> Array:
starter:
func solve(a: int, b: int) -> Array:
	return []
hint: Square brackets make an array: `return [a + b, a * b]`.
solution:
func solve(a: int, b: int) -> Array:
	return [a + b, a * b]
